{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Prince Ulrik of Denmark, (2 February 1611 - 12 August 1633) was a son of King Christian IV of Denmark and his consort Queen Anne Catherine of Brandenburg.","title":"Ulrik of Denmark (1611–1633)"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" As the fourth-born son, he bore the merely titular rank of Duke of Holstein and Schleswig, Stormarn and Ditmarsh; however, he had no share in the royal-ducal condominial rule of Holstein and Schleswig, wielded by the heads of the houses of Oldenburg (royal) and its cadet branch Holstein-Gottorp (ducal).","title":"Ulrik of Denmark (1611–1633)"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" In 1624 Ulrik was appointed administrator of the Prince-Bishopric of Schwerin as Ulrich III.","title":"Ulrik of Denmark (1611–1633)"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" However, in 1628 Wallenstein's conquest of the prince-bishopric de facto deposed him.","title":"Ulrik of Denmark (1611–1633)"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" His father had to renounce all his family claims to prince-bishoprics in 1629.","title":"Ulrik of Denmark (1611–1633)"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" When in 1631 Swedish forces reconquered the prince-bishopric Ulrik failed to reascend as administrator.","title":"Ulrik of Denmark (1611–1633)"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Princess Augusta of Denmark (8 April 1580 – 5 February 1639) was the third daughter of King Frederick II of Denmark and Sophia of Mecklenburg-Güstrow, and Duchess of Holstein-Gottorp as the wife of Duke John Adolf.","title":"Augusta of Denmark"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" She was politically influential during the reign of her son, Duke Frederick III.","title":"Augusta of Denmark"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: noanswer","Unverified peer answer: noanswer"],"previous_answer":"noanswer","question":"Prince Ulrik John of Denmark was the song of Frederick II of Denmark, the King of Denmark and which other country?"}
